core.text: The primary cost for both GEA and DGM arises from benchmark evaluation. Since we generate the same number of agents for both methods, their overall costs are very similar. Following the settings described in Sections 4.2 and 4.3, the estimated cost of completing a full run is approximately USD 13,000 per method on SWE-bench and USD 1,500 on Polyglot.
